findings.criterion_text: All non-text content that is presented to the user has a text alternative that serves the equivalent purpose.
findings.finding_description: Hero banner image has no alt attribute
findings.disability_impact: Screen reader users hear only the file name or nothing at all, missing the primary visual message of the page.
findings.critique_citation: All non-text content that is presented to the user has a text alternative that serves the equivalent purpose.

fix.review_reason: Alt text is AI-generated from surrounding context. Confirm it matches the image's actual intent.

findings.criterion_text: The size of the target for pointer inputs is at least 24 by 24 CSS pixels.
findings.finding_description: Close button is 16x16px — below the minimum touch target size
findings.disability_impact: Users with tremor or limited fine motor control cannot reliably activate a 16px target, especially on touch devices.
findings.critique_citation: The size of the target for pointer inputs is at least 24 by 24 CSS pixels.

findings.criterion_text: Labels or instructions are provided when content requires user input.
findings.finding_description: Email field relies on placeholder text as its only label
findings.disability_impact: Placeholder text disappears on input, so users with memory impairments lose the field's purpose mid-task.
findings.critique_citation: Labels or instructions are provided when content requires user input.

findings.criterion_text: Information, structure, and relationships conveyed through presentation can be programmatically determined or are available in text.
findings.finding_description: Data table has no caption and no header cells
findings.disability_impact: Screen readers announce a grid of unlabeled values with no way to associate data with its meaning.
findings.critique_citation: Information, structure, and relationships conveyed through presentation can be programmatically determined or are available in text.

news_preview.headline: W3C publishes updated APCA guidance in WCAG 3.0 working draft
news_preview.summary: The Advanced Perceptual Contrast Algorithm draft now includes font-weight-aware thresholds, signaling the eventual replacement of the 4.5:1 ratio.

news_preview.headline: Indian government portals face RPwD Act Section 46 audit sweep
news_preview.summary: A nationwide accessibility review of government-funded websites cites missing language attributes and unlabeled forms as the most common failures.
